topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I tell you, the trouble with these newfangled contraptions is not just that they’re hard to understand, but that they’re snatched up by the first fella with coin to spare. My son comes up with a clever wheel to lift water from the well, thinking it could ease the toil of the village. Before the summer’s end, a lord from over the hills has laid claim to it, with parchment and seal. Now, we’re told to buy what we already know or do without. It’s like the rain deciding to charge us for falling on our crops. Seems there’s no end to the ways a man can be cheated, even with his own cleverness turned against him.
